verdict.rationale: Linear's public GraphQL API is described as 'the same API we use internally' and supports issue creation, webhooks, OAuth2, and a typed SDK (linear-docs-49,50,53,74), suggesting broad parity with UI actions. However, there is no evidence that newer UI-only surfaces (Loops, Agent skills, initiatives, mobile document editing, admin spend limits) have documented API equivalents, so full 1:1 parity is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit API coverage for Loops/Agent workflows, initiatives, and admin settings, plus independent confirmation that every UI action has an API counterpart.
